Former Leeds striker on Disney + 
 That's what you've got from Bunny Shaw, a ball into space and watch what she does. 
 Sometimes having her in the team is like a cheat code. They were under pressure, Shaw keeps her composure and finds the back of the net.

 GOAL - Hacken 0-2 Man City published at 19:20 GMT 19:20 GMT 
 Khadija Shaw (77 mins) 
 Khadija Shaw gives Manchester City some breathing space.
 The Jamaica striker puts her foot on the gas and surges up the pitch, ready to receive Lauren Hemp's pass.
 She still has a lot of work to do, but she holds off Hacken's defenders and it's a composed finish past Jennifer Falk.

 Image source, Getty Images Breakthrough! 
 Lauren Hemp laughs with her team-mates after a Hacken defender tries to clear the ball - only to see it ricochet off Hemps shin and into the bottom right corner of the goal.
 Manchester City haven't had much luck this evening, but they get a big dose of it there!

 Team news - No Bronze, Bjorn captains Chelsea published at 18:56 GMT 18:56 GMT 
 Chelsea v Paris St-Germain (20:00 GMT) 
 Emma Sanders 
BBC Sport women’s football news reporter at Plough Lane 
 There are three changes to the Chelsea side who beat Manchester City on the weekend. 
 Aggie Beever-Jones comes in for the injured Melvine Malard up front, while there is no Lucy Bronze in the squad.
 Kadeisha Buchanan, who was substituted after 12 minutes in that match and was ruled fit to play, is on the bench. 
 In comes in-form defender Veerle Buurman, while Nathalie Bjorn captains the team tonight.
 Chelsea XI : Hampton, Bjorn, Buurman, McCabe, Potter, Walsh, Thompson, Carpenter, Kaptein, Baltimore, Beever-Jones.
 Subs : Peng, Spencer, Buchanan, Las, Cuthbert, Dragoni, Nusken, Hamano, Brown.
 Paris St-Germain : Kiedrzynek, Samoura, Echegini, Chagas, Groenen, Feller, Kanjinga, Elimbi Gilbert, Le Guilly, Mbock Bathy, Osteras. 
 Subs : Toussaint, Peda, Carmona, Yaya, Charlier, Jourde, Le Roux, Imarazene, Morissaint, Lafontaine, Fatier, Dudek.

 Hacken 0-0 Man City 
 Hacken's fans have had little to cheer about when it comes to attacking play, but suddenly they pose a threat to Manchester City's goal.
 Anna Anvegard's shot is well blocked by Gracie Prior, who makes another vital interception moments later.
